records.source: MSP overflow field-capacity and national partner research archive, 2026
records.buyer_type: MSPs, POS integrators, technology vendors, and national service-delivery firms
records.example_target_company_or_market: Out-of-state providers with Arizona customers and insufficient local technician coverage
records.contact_path: Vendor management, service-delivery manager, partner operations, procurement, or field-services leadership
records.pain_solved: Coverage gaps, emergency dispatch risk, inconsistent closeouts, and the cost of hiring permanent local staff.
records.estimated_ticket_value: $2,000-$6,000 monthly reserved-capacity retainer plus approved dispatch work
records.cost_required: $0 new spend using existing field-service capability and documentation
records.startup_requirements: Coverage matrix, SLA options, rate card, dispatch minimums, supported-trade list, escalation path, COI, W-9, and sample closeout
records.first_10_target_strategy: Identify ten MSPs or national providers serving Arizona without dedicated local coverage; prioritize existing relationships and public partner channels.

records.notes: One of the strongest recurring lanes because it converts existing field expertise into retainer-backed local coverage.
